title.en: Ravana Kaviyam (இராவண காவியம்) by Pulavar Kuzhandhai

text.en: A garden of green trees, rivers and birds opens this poem.

Ravana Kaviyam, by Pulavar Kuzhandhai, is a modern epic that tells the Ramayana story from the side of Ravana. The textbook poem opens with a vivid description of a garden full of flowers, trees, river banks, deer, peacocks, cuckoos and parrots.
The poem shows how a poet's words paint nature and how a reader can enjoy the beauty of language. It is one of the memorisation poems.
Terms: காவியம் (epic), இயற்கை வருணனை (nature description), புலவர் குழந்தை and மனப்பாடம்.
